what_this_is: The two halves of the PDM work, merged. Neither half is usable alone: GPT/PDM_RAW on SharePoint holds a source register for all 18 municipalities and the phase-1 acquisition status, but no vector data — that sits on Google Drive. porto_pdm_claude/ in this repository holds a deep, evidence-backed probe of 4 municipalities and no register. There is zero overlap in what they establish, which is why §8 of the handoff asked for this merge.
